work_unit.title: 实现飞书 Channel Connector 纵向切片
work_unit.goal: 通过版本化 Plugin SDK Channel Connector 合同接入飞书安全 webhook、群聊和私聊 Conversation 绑定、幂等消息、规范化回复，以及仅由已映射授权真人触发的显式 Target Draft。

authority_rules: Signature, encryption, verification-token or app-id failure rejects before any durable Conversation fact.
The Host binds one Workspace, plugin connection and external conversation; provider payload cannot choose another scope after verification.
Provider event id is durably unique per Workspace, connector and connection, including concurrent delivery.
Ordinary messages only append ConversationMessage. Draft creation requires an explicit normalized intent and a provider-user to local-user authorization mapping.
Provider identifiers and diagnostics stay in adapter metadata and never become Target title, goal or acceptance semantics.

tdd_plan.red: Add challenge, invalid signature/encryption/token/app, replay, concurrent duplicate, group/direct binding, ordinary message, explicit draft and unauthorized-provider-user tests.
tdd_plan.green: Add the minimum V1 contract, Feishu adapter, worker RPC return path, durable event inbox and Host transaction.
tdd_plan.refactor: Keep provider parsing and reply transport in the plugin while the Host consumes only normalized V1 events.

required_items: sandbox delivery and reply ids or named T010 prerequisite

stop_conditions: A provider callback can write before cryptographic and connection binding checks pass.
Draft confirmation relies on an unmapped provider identity or a fabricated local user.
A replay can create a second ConversationMessage or Draft.
The plugin must leak an app secret, verification token or encryption key into durable facts.
